question: Can the differential/ramification torsion of the normalization map of a hypothetical integral genus-1 V6 carrier force a contradiction with the required total normalization defect delta=472, without first knowing the actual singularity support/types?

ex1_00.exact_use: Fixed V6 numerical target D^2=758, K.D=186, p_a=473, target geometric genus 1, required total delta=472.

ex1_03.exact_use: Away from the exceptional divisor, an integral V6 carrier has reduced plane-curve singularity germs on a smooth surface; local equations/Puiseux/semigroup/tangency data remain unrestricted by the retained package.

global_exact_shadow.interpretation: The total Gorenstein conductor degree 2*delta is numerically fixed at 944, but this does not determine differential ramification of the normalization map.

two_smooth_branches_high_contact.normalization: k[[t]] direct_sum k[[t]] with x -> (t,t), y -> (t^472,-t^472)
two_smooth_branches_high_contact.image_characterization: pairs (u,v) with u-v divisible by t^472
two_smooth_branches_high_contact.delta_derivation: normalization/image is isomorphic as a k-vector-space quotient to k[[t]]/(t^472), hence delta=472
two_smooth_branches_high_contact.semantic_use: A full 472 units of plane-curve normalization defect can be stored in contact of two smooth branches while the normalization map is immersive on both branches.

unibranch_semigroup_cusp.semantic_use: A full 472 units of defect can also occur on one branch with only one unit of differential vanishing.

bounded_consequence.reason: The two exact reduced plane-curve germs have the same delta=472 and conductor degree 944 but differential ramification lengths 0 and 1. Therefore any route using only tangent-map torsion/ramification to force a large fraction of the V6 defect is invalid without additional V6-specific singularity restrictions.
bounded_consequence.scope: This is a local method counterexample, not a claim that either germ is globally realized by a V6 carrier.

decision.reopen_condition: Supply a V6-specific theorem or source-bound local classification excluding high-contact smooth-branch germs and high-delta low-multiplicity unibranch germs, or otherwise coupling the actual singularity types/support to normalization differential vanishing.

next_route.selection_reason: Use the already-retained simultaneous degree-105 and degree-81 maps from the common-cover normalization to genus-2 targets and test whether a source-bound Castelnuovo-Severi type inequality adds any independent restriction before entering the heavier Hurwitz-space dimension route.
